name: Moko
description: Moko 原生形态键（eye_wink2_L、eye_scornful_L、mouth_raise_L、eyebrow_negative_L、pupil_up 等）。标了 guessed 的需要游戏实测。
description_en: Moko's native shape keys (eye_wink2_L, eye_scornful_L, mouth_raise_L, eyebrow_negative_L, pupil_up, ...). Mappings marked guessed need testing in game.

channels.name: eyebrow_up_L
channels.note: 眉毛上移（左侧）。最大位移 10.4mm（moko）。整条眉毛上移。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 browRaise.L，取较大者
channels.note_en: Brow up (left). Max displacement 10.4 mm (moko). Whole brow up. Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal browRaise.L, the larger wins

channels.name: eyebrow_up_R
channels.note: 眉毛上移（右侧）。最大位移 10.4mm（moko）。整条眉毛上移。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 browRaise.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Brow up (right). Max displacement 10.4 mm (moko). Whole brow up. Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal browRaise.R, the larger wins

channels.name: eyebrow_down_L
channels.note: 眉毛下压（左侧）。最大位移 10.0mm（moko）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 browLower.L，取较大者
channels.note_en: Brow down (left). Max displacement 10.0 mm (moko). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal browLower.L, the larger wins

channels.name: eyebrow_down_R
channels.note: 眉毛下压（右侧）。最大位移 10.0mm（moko）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 browLower.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Brow down (right). Max displacement 10.0 mm (moko). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal browLower.R, the larger wins

channels.name: eyebrow_lower_L
channels.note: 眉头上提（左侧）。最大位移 13.8mm（moko）。eyebrow_lower 名字是“下”，实测是眉头上提、眉尾下垂
channels.note_en: Inner brow up (left). Max displacement 13.8 mm (moko). eyebrow_lower is named "lower", but measures as inner brow up, outer brow down

channels.name: eyebrow_lower_R
channels.note: 眉头上提（右侧）。最大位移 13.8mm（moko）。eyebrow_lower 名字是“下”，实测是眉头上提、眉尾下垂
channels.note_en: Inner brow up (right). Max displacement 13.8 mm (moko). eyebrow_lower is named "lower", but measures as inner brow up, outer brow down

channels.name: eyebrow_negative_L
channels.note: 眉头下压（皱眉）（左侧）。最大位移 18.0mm（moko）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 browInnerDown.L，取较大者
channels.note_en: Inner brow down (frown) (left). Max displacement 18.0 mm (moko). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal browInnerDown.L, the larger wins

channels.name: eyebrow_negative_R
channels.note: 眉头下压（皱眉）（右侧）。最大位移 18.0mm（moko）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 browInnerDown.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Inner brow down (frown) (right). Max displacement 18.0 mm (moko). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal browInnerDown.R, the larger wins

channels.name: eye_wink2_L
channels.note: 闭眼（左侧）。最大位移 15.4mm（moko）。单眼闭眼键（wink2）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 eyeClose.L，取较大者
channels.note_en: Eye closed (left). Max displacement 15.4 mm (moko). One-eye close key (wink2). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal eyeClose.L, the larger wins

channels.name: eye_wink2_R
channels.note: 闭眼（右侧）。最大位移 15.4mm（moko）。单眼闭眼键（wink2）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 eyeClose.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Eye closed (right). Max displacement 15.4 mm (moko). One-eye close key (wink2). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal eyeClose.R, the larger wins

channels.name: eye_scornful_L
channels.note: 上眼睑下降、眼裂缩小（左侧）。最大位移 5.2mm（moko）
channels.note_en: Upper lid lowers, eye narrows (left). Max displacement 5.2 mm (moko)

channels.name: eye_scornful_R
channels.note: 上眼睑下降、眼裂缩小（右侧）。最大位移 5.2mm（moko）
channels.note_en: Upper lid lowers, eye narrows (right). Max displacement 5.2 mm (moko)

channels.name: eye_surprized_L
channels.note: 睁大眼（左侧）。最大位移 2.5mm（moko）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 eyeWiden.L，取较大者
channels.note_en: Eye wide open (left). Max displacement 2.5 mm (moko). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal eyeWiden.L, the larger wins

channels.name: eye_surprized_R
channels.note: 睁大眼（右侧）。最大位移 2.5mm（moko）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 eyeWiden.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Eye wide open (right). Max displacement 2.5 mm (moko). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal eyeWiden.R, the larger wins

channels.name: eye_lowereyelid_raise_L
channels.note: 下眼睑上提（笑眼下睑分量）（左侧）。最大位移 1.3mm（moko）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 cheekRaise.L，取较大者
channels.note_en: Lower lid raised (the lower-lid part of a smiling eye) (left). Max displacement 1.3 mm (moko). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal cheekRaise.L, the larger wins

channels.name: eye_lowereyelid_raise_R
channels.note: 下眼睑上提（笑眼下睑分量）（右侧）。最大位移 1.3mm（moko）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 cheekRaise.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Lower lid raised (the lower-lid part of a smiling eye) (right). Max displacement 1.3 mm (moko). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal cheekRaise.R, the larger wins

channels.name: cheek_plump_L
channels.note: 脸颊鼓起（左侧）。最大位移 3.9mm（moko）
channels.note_en: Cheek puffed (left). Max displacement 3.9 mm (moko)

channels.name: cheek_plump_R
channels.note: 脸颊鼓起（右侧）。最大位移 3.9mm（moko）
channels.note_en: Cheek puffed (right). Max displacement 3.9 mm (moko)

channels.name: mouth_aa
channels.note: 张嘴。最大位移 7.6mm（moko）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 jawDrop，取较大者
channels.note_en: Mouth open. Max displacement 7.6 mm (moko). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal jawDrop, the larger wins

channels.name: mouth_ou
channels.note: u 口型（嘴唇收拢）；左右合一的键，左右信号各取一半。最大位移 7.1mm（moko）
channels.note_en: "u" mouth shape (lips rounded); one key for both sides, half of each side's signal. Max displacement 7.1 mm (moko)

channels.name: mouth_raise_L
channels.note: 嘴角上扬（左侧）。最大位移 2.4mm（moko）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 mouthCornerUp.L，取较大者
channels.note_en: Mouth corner up (left). Max displacement 2.4 mm (moko). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal mouthCornerUp.L, the larger wins

channels.name: mouth_raise_R
channels.note: 嘴角上扬（右侧）。最大位移 2.4mm（moko）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 mouthCornerUp.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Mouth corner up (right). Max displacement 2.4 mm (moko). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal mouthCornerUp.R, the larger wins

channels.name: mouth_lower_L
channels.note: 嘴角下垂（左侧）。最大位移 1.7mm（moko）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 mouthCornerDown.L，取较大者
channels.note_en: Mouth corner down (left). Max displacement 1.7 mm (moko). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal mouthCornerDown.L, the larger wins

channels.name: mouth_lower_R
channels.note: 嘴角下垂（右侧）。最大位移 1.7mm（moko）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 mouthCornerDown.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Mouth corner down (right). Max displacement 1.7 mm (moko). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal mouthCornerDown.R, the larger wins

channels.name: mouth_widen
channels.note: 嘴角向外、嘴变宽；左右合一的键，左右信号各取一半。最大位移 7.1mm（moko）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 mouthCornerOut.L / mouthCornerOut.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Mouth corner out, mouth wider; one key for both sides, half of each side's signal. Max displacement 7.1 mm (moko). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal mouthCornerOut.L / mouthCornerOut.R, the larger wins

channels.name: pupil_up
channels.note: 虹膜上移。最大位移 2.0mm（moko）。视线方向按 Shinano 游戏实测换算：虹膜移向角色自身左侧(+X) 对应 yaw +1。
channels.note_en: Iris up. Max displacement 2.0 mm (moko). Gaze direction converted as measured in game on Shinano: iris toward the character's own left (+X) = yaw +1.

channels.name: pupil_down
channels.note: 虹膜下移。最大位移 2.1mm（moko）。视线方向按 Shinano 游戏实测换算：虹膜移向角色自身左侧(+X) 对应 yaw +1。
channels.note_en: Iris down. Max displacement 2.1 mm (moko). Gaze direction converted as measured in game on Shinano: iris toward the character's own left (+X) = yaw +1.

channels.name: pupil_left
channels.note: 虹膜移向角色左侧。最大位移 5.2mm（moko）。视线方向按 Shinano 游戏实测换算：虹膜移向角色自身左侧(+X) 对应 yaw +1。
channels.note_en: Iris to the character's left. Max displacement 5.2 mm (moko). Gaze direction converted as measured in game on Shinano: iris toward the character's own left (+X) = yaw +1.

channels.name: pupil_right
channels.note: 虹膜移向角色右侧。最大位移 5.2mm（moko）。视线方向按 Shinano 游戏实测换算：虹膜移向角色自身左侧(+X) 对应 yaw +1。
channels.note_en: Iris to the character's right. Max displacement 5.2 mm (moko). Gaze direction converted as measured in game on Shinano: iris toward the character's own left (+X) = yaw +1.
